items.title: Move Aside Retatrutide, Eli Lilly Just Beat Its Next-Gen Obesity Drug
items.summary: Eli Lilly already beat its next-generation weight-loss drug, retatrutide, and it hasn't even hit the market.

items.title: Are You Overpaying For Pfizer Stock Versus Its Rivals?
items.summary: Pfizer's shares cost more than Johnson & Johnson's for each dollar of reported profit, even after factoring in a loss quarter over the past year. Investors usually pay more for growth, yet Pfizer (PFE) had the weakest sales growth of the six companies in its peer group. Are you overpaying for Pfizer stock versus its rivals.

items.title: Eli Lilly stock rises on striking 23% weight loss in drug combo trial
items.summary: Investing.com -- Shares of Eli Lilly and Company (NYSE: LLY) climbed as much as 2.6% before settling up 0.5% after the pharmaceutical giant reported highly positive Phase 2b trial results for its new obesity and type 2 diabetes drug combination. As Lilly’s stock advanced, shares of primary competitor Novo Nordisk slipped 0.3% on the news.

items.title: What Is Merck Stock's Biggest Opportunity?
items.summary: Merck (MRK) stock returned 96% in the past twelve months, against 16.8% for the S&P 500. With the shares 4.0% below their 52-week high, you need a reason Merck can keep growing. In its fiscal Q2 2026 call, management looked past its best-selling drug to newer ones. So what is Merck stock's biggest opportunity from here.

items.title: Lilly’s Next-Gen Obesity Drug Helps People Lose Even More Weight in Study
items.summary: A drug combination studied in people with Type 2 diabetes lowered blood sugar and helped people lose more weight than with Zepbound alone.

items.title: Novo Nordisk Wegovy pill weight loss switch study results
items.summary: A real-world study of 194 patients found those who switched to the daily pill lost an average of 8.8 pounds over 3 months

items.title: Can Novo's Licensing Strategy Build Its Next Wave of Oral Medicines?
items.summary: NVO's latest Hengrui deal adds a phase I-ready, once-weekly oral GLP-1/GIP candidate, building on deals for oral drug-delivery tech and small-molecule approaches.

items.title: Opinion: Eli Lilly Stock Is a No-Brainer Pick to Buy on the Dip
